questions.question:
Select the option that is related to the third word in the same way as the second word is related to the first word. (The words must be considered as meaningful English words and must NOT be related to each other based on the number of letters/number of consonants/vowels in the word.)

Lizard ∶ Crawl ∶∶ Snake ∶ ? __________
questions.solution:
The pattern used in the given pair is:

**Lizard ∶ Crawl** - Animal : Action of movement

Similarly,

**Snake ****∶**** ?** - ? will be the action of movement of snake.

We consider the given options: 

1) Gallop - A snake does not gallop.

2) Slide - A snake does not slide.

3) Slither - A snake does slithers.

4) Jump - A snake does not jump.

Hence the correct answer is option 3)

A # B' means A is the brother of B'.

'A @ B' means 'A is the daughter of B'.

'A % B' means 'A is the wife of B'.

If V & S @ F % H # T & Q, then how is S related to H?
questions.solution:
From the given information:

'A # B' means A is the brother of B'.

'A @ B' means 'A is the daughter of B'.

'A & B' means 'A is the husband of B'.

'A % B' means 'A is the wife of B'.

Now we substitute the values in the given equation and draw a tree using the symbols:

: [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/abf25944776d2a3ecedfc8ce453d6240c47cfde66b9c3a1ec4348e9237131af8.png] 

V is the husband of S, S is the daughter of F, F is the wife of H, H is the brother of T, T is the husband of Q.

From the tree we can see that, **S is the daughter of H.**

Hence **the correct answer is option 1)**

questions.question:
Select the option that represents the letters which when sequentially placed from left to right in the blanks below will complete the letter series.

L _ J _ G _ K _ H G _ K J H _ L _ _ H G

options.text: K I L K L G K I
K I L K L H K J
K H L J L G K J
K I L J L G K J

questions.solution:
Given: L _ J _ G _ K _ H G _ K J H _ L _ _ H G

Let's check each option:

1) K I L K L G K I → L __**K**__ J __**I**__ G - __**L**__ K __K__ H G - __L__ K J H __**G -**__ L __K__ __I__ H G

2) K I L K L H K J → L __K__ J __I__ G - __L__ K __K__ H G - __L__ K J H __**H**__ - L __K__ __J__ H G

3) **K H L J L G K J** → L __K__ J __H__ G - __L__ K __J__ H G - __**L**__ K J H __G__ - L __K__ __J__ H G

4) K I L J L G K J → L __K__ J __I__ G - __L__ K __**J**__ H G - __L__ K J H __G__ - L __K__ __J__ H G

So, In option 3 "L K J H G" is repeating itself.

Hence, ‘K H L J L G K J’ is the correct answer.

questions.question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true even if it seems to be at variance from commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follows from the given statements.

Statement:

Some bulbs are tube lights.

Some tube lights are switches.

No switch is wire.

conclusion:

I. Some tube lights are bulbs.

II. No switch is bulb.

III. No wire is tube light.

options.text: Only conclusions I and III follow
Only conclusions II and III follow
Only conclusions I and II follow

questions.solution:
From the given statement, Venn diagram is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/58d5afafb0a8b6d6e6544ebca03dbcacbbf992748071794a68662daf9d20b803.png] 

Conclusions:

I. Some tube lights are bulbs → Follow → Because some bulbs are tube lights it can also be said that some tubes are light bulbs and hence the conclusion follows.

II. No switch is bulb → does not follow → Since some bulbs are tube lights and some tube lights are switches, there is a possibility that bulbs are related to switches and this possibility cannot be ignored, hence making the conclusion false and Thus the conclusion does not follow. 

III. No wire is tube light → does not follow → As 

There is no switch wire but we cannot assume that the wires are not related to bulb and tube light and due to lack of information we cannot come to the conclusion that no wire is tube light and thus do not follow the conclusion. 

Since the only conclusion I follow.

Hence, the correct answer is option 1)
